narrative: Late into the night, a young calligrapher stared at a sprawling, empty parchment. Her hands trembled under the weight of her ambitious design; she wanted to capture the entire cosmos in ink, but every attempt collapsed into chaotic clutter. Her mentor approached silently, dipped a coarse brush into dark ink, and made a single, clean stroke—the very first letter of the alphabet. In the quiet stillness of the room, the lesson clicked. Every complex poem, ancient scripture, and boundless story ever written relies entirely on that humble first character. Without the letter 'A', no words can form; without the primordial origin, the vast universe itself cannot exist. Grounding herself in this truth, her anxiety faded into focus. Today, when we feel overwhelmed by the vastness of our goals or the chaos of existence, we must remember that everything traces back to a singular, divine foundation. Recognizing the ultimate source of all things brings clarity to where we stand and where we must begin.
takeaway: Just as all speech begins with the first letter, every creation rests upon its primordial source.
